items.title: Ex-Google DeepMind researcher adds to warnings that AI could 'kill all humans'
items.summary: A former DeepMind safety researcher added to a widening industry debate over catastrophic AI risk, coordination and the pace of frontier development.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang rejects an AI slowdown
items.summary: Nvidia's CEO pushed back against calls to slow frontier AI development, putting infrastructure economics and safety governance in direct tension.

items.title: King Charles to host AI executives as threat fears mount
items.summary: Major AI executives are being brought together in the UK as policymakers and industry leaders debate whether shared principles are needed for increasingly capable systems.

items.title: OpenAI publishes a new wave of product, engineering and applied-AI updates
items.summary: OpenAI's September news stream includes Agents API, GPT-6 Astra, financial-services tooling, voice APIs and infrastructure engineering updates.

items.title: Anthropic updates its reporting on detecting and countering AI misuse
items.summary: Anthropic's September threat-intelligence reporting describes malicious-use patterns and defensive interventions around advanced model access.

items.title: Anthropic explains Claude text watermarking and EU transition requirements
items.summary: Anthropic describes its text watermarking approach and notes the EU transition period for models launched before 2 August 2026.

items.title: European Commission starts enforcing AI Act rules and transparency requirements
items.summary: From 2 August 2026, the AI Office and national authorities moved into enforcement while new transparency duties for AI interactions and generated content began to apply.

items.title: AI Omnibus enters into force across the EU
items.summary: The 2026 AI Omnibus introduces targeted simplification and timeline changes while retaining safeguards around safety and fundamental rights.

items.title: 29 countries sign agreement establishing WAICO in Shanghai
items.summary: The World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization was established as an independent intergovernmental organization headquartered in Shanghai, focused on international cooperation and global AI governance.

items.title: Meta introduces Muse Spark 1.1
items.summary: Meta's AI research stream continues to expand its Muse model family alongside broader work in multimodal systems and open research.
